meta.value: Units in this ledger were examined once before, by the v0 development run on 2026-10-14 (archived as data/discovery-ledger-dev-run1-2026-10-14.db), whose results informed the v0.1 changes. Evidence from these units is therefore not strictly first-look; units created by new data are.

The v1 families were designed on 2026-10-14 by people who had seen these trials' published results (the scenario model is fit on them). Units on trials already in the corpus are therefore not strictly first-look; units created by new data are.

Topline check 2026-10-14 (forecasts/TOPLINE-CHECK-2026-10-14.md): Tranquillo NCT05583526 (4), Tranquillo 2 NCT06072183 (4) and Viti-Up NCT06118411 (4) had public toplines before sealing (Pfizer 2026-07-30 and EADV 2026-10-03; AbbVie 2025-10-29). Only the 3 ruxolitinib pediatric forecasts (NCT06548360, NCT06804811) are prospective.

discovery loop v0.1 for tests t <= 4; v1 from t = 5: adds regimen-pair units (families regimen_contrast and dose_retention, linear-null mixture e-values), power-ordered units within a round, and selection blind to the held-out trial's own earlier results; one e-LOND stream at alpha = 0.10 across all families
